tamil.text:
அகர முதல எழுத்தெல்லாம் ஆதி
பகவன் முதற்றே உலகு.

english.text: 'A' leads letters; the Ancient Lord Leads and lords the entire world
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: As the letter A is the first of all letters, so the eternal God is first in the world

நற்றாள் தொழாஅர் எனின்.

english.text: That lore is vain which does not fall At His good feet who knoweth all
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: What Profit have those derived from learning, who worship not the good feet of Him who is possessed of pure knowledge ?

நிலமிசை நீடுவாழ் வார்.

english.text: Long they live on earth who gain The feet of God in florid brain
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: They who are united to the glorious feet of Him who passes swiftly over the flower of the mind, shall flourish long above all worlds

யாண்டும் இடும்பை இல.

english.text: Who hold His feet who likes nor loathes Are free from woes of human births
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: To those who meditate the feet of Him who is void of desire or aversion, evil shall never come

பொருள்சேர் புகழ்புரிந்தார் மாட்டு.

english.text: God's praise who tell, are free from right And wrong, the twins of dreaming night
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The two-fold deeds that spring from darkness shall not adhere to those who delight in the true praise of God

நெறிநின்றார் நீடுவாழ் வார்.

english.text: They prosper long who walk His way Who has the senses signed away
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Those shall long proposer who abide in the faultless way of Him who has destroyed the five desires of the senses

மனக்கவலை மாற்றல் அரிது.

english.text: His feet, whose likeness none can find, Alone can ease the anxious mind
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Anxiety of mind cannot be removed, except from those who are united to the feet of Him who is incomparable

பிறவாழி நீந்தல் அரிது.

english.text: Who swims the sea of vice is he Who clasps the feet of Virtue's sea
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: None can swim the sea of vice, but those who are united to the feet of that gracious Being who is a sea of virtue

தாளை வணங்காத் தலை.

english.text: Like senses stale that head is vain Which bows not to Eight-Virtued Divine
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The head that worships not the feet of Him who is possessed of eight attributes, is as useless as a sense without the power of sensation

இறைவன் அடிசேரா தார்.

english.text: The sea of births they alone swim Who clench His feet and cleave to Him
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: None can swim the great sea of births but those who are united to the feet of God

தான்அமிழ்தம் என்றுணரற் பாற்று.

english.text: The genial rain ambrosia call: The world but lasts while rain shall fall
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: By the continuance of rain the world is preserved in existence; it is therefore worthy to be called ambrosia

துப்பாய தூஉம் மழை.

english.text: The rain begets the food we eat
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Rain produces good food, and is itself food

உள்நின்று உடற்றும் பசி.

english.text: Let clouds their visits stay, and dearth Distresses all the sea-girt earth
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If the cloud, withholding rain, deceive (our hopes) hunger will long distress the sea-girt spacious world

வாரி வளங்குன்றிக் கால்.

english.text: Unless the fruitful shower descend, The ploughman's sacred toil must end
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If the abundance of wealth imparting rain diminish, the labour of the plough must cease

எடுப்பதூஉம் எல்லாம் மழை.

english.text: Destruction it may sometimes pour But only rain can life restore
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Rain by its absence ruins men; and by its existence restores them to fortune

பசும்புல் தலைகாண்பு அரிது.

english.text: No grassy blade its head will rear, If from the cloud no drop appear
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If no drop falls from the clouds, not even the green blade of grass will be seen

தான்நல்கா தாகி விடின்.

english.text: The ocean's wealth will waste away, Except the cloud its stores repay
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Even the wealth of the wide sea will be diminished, if the cloud that has drawn (its waters) up gives them not back again (in rain)

வறக்குமேல் வானோர்க்கும் ஈண்டு.

english.text: The earth, beneath a barren sky, Would offerings for the gods deny
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If the heaven dry up, neither yearly festivals, nor daily worship will be offered in this world, to the celestials

வானம் வழங்கா தெனின்.

english.text: Were heaven above to fail below Nor alms nor penance earth would show
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If rain fall not, penance and alms-deeds will not dwell within this spacious world

வான்இன்று அமையாது ஒழுக்கு.

english.text: Water is life that comes from rain Sans rain our duties go in vain
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: If it be said that the duties of life cannot be discharged by any person without water, so without rain there cannot be the flowing of water

வேண்டும் பனுவல் துணிவு.

english.text: No merit can be held so high As theirs who sense and self deny
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The end and aim of all treatise is to extol beyond all other excellence, the greatness of those who, while abiding in the rule of conduct peculiar to their state, have abandoned all desire

இறந்தாரை எண்ணிக்கொண் டற்று.

english.text: To con ascetic glory here Is to count the dead upon the sphere
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: To describe the measure of the greatness of those who have forsaken the two-fold desires, is like counting the dead

பெருமை பிறங்கிற்று உலகு.

english.text: No lustre can with theirs compare Who know the right and virtue wear
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The greatness of those who have discovered the properties of both states of being, and renounced the world, shines forth on earth (beyond all others)

வரனென்னும் வைப்பிற்கோர் வித்து.

english.text: With hook of firmness to restrain The senses five, is heaven to gain
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: He who guides his five senses by the hook of wisdom will be a seed in the world of heaven

இந்திரனே சாலுங் கரி.

english.text: Indra himself has cause to say How great the power ascetics' sway
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: Indra, the king of the inhabitants of the spacious heaven, is himself, a sufficient proof of the strength of him who has subdued his five senses

செயற்கரிய செய்கலா தார்.

english.text: The small the paths of ease pursue The great achieve things rare to do
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The great will do those things which is difficult to be done; but the mean cannot do them

வகைதெரிவான் கட்டே உலகு.

english.text: They gain the world, who grasp and tell Of taste, sight, hearing, touch and smell
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: The world is within the knowledge of him who knows the properties of taste, sight, touch, hearing and smell

மறைமொழி காட்டி விடும்.

english.text: Full-worded men by what they say, Their greatness to the world display

மிக்லூக்கும் தன்மை யவர்.

தவலும் கெடலும் நணித்து.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

இன்னா அறிவி னவர்.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

மிக்லூக்கின் ஊக்குமாம் கேடு.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

மிகல்காணும் கேடு தரற்கு.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: At the approach of wealth one will not think of hatred (but) to secure one's ruin, one will look to its increase

நன்னயம் என்னும் செருக்கு.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

என்பரியும் ஏதிலான் துப்பு.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

தஞ்சம் எளியன் பகைக்கு.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
english.easy_text: In the estimation of foes miserably weak is he, who is timid, ignorant, unsociable and niggardly

யாங்கணும் யார்க்கும் எளிது.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

பண்பிலன் பற்றார்க்கு இனிது.

english.text: Crooked, cruel, tactless and base Any foe can fell him with ease
english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

பேணாமை பேணப் படும்.

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)

english.translator: Kaviyogi Maharishi Shuddhananda Bharatiyar (credited in the Project Madurai bilingual etext)
